definition: A sailing ship with two masts and a particular arrangement of sails.
book: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
quote: All the sails were up, and the jib was so arranged as not to screen the brigantine.
example_sentence: A brigantine with red sails drifted into the harbour.
